Priya Rao: quick question about PTO carryover and mid-year FTE changes. I accepted a parental partial leave and will be 0.6 FTE from 2026-06-01 to 2026-09-30. I currently have ~32h PTO. Can those hours carry over past the annual cutoff?
Jamal (People Ops): hey Priya - short answer: we have a carryover policy and an LOA exception flow. Regular carryover cap is 80 hours per year. For people on approved LOA we can do a manual adjustment if paperwork is submitted.
Priya Rao: cool. Is there any effect from moving to 0.6 FTE mid-year on accruals?
Jamal (People Ops): yes, accruals are prorated by FTE starting the first day of the FTE change. So your accrual rate will drop from full-time to 0.6 from 2026-06-01 onward. That does not retroactively change already-accrued balances.
Tess Nguyen: @Priya Rao I approved your LOA form yesterday and mentioned the FTE change. I can add a note to the HR ticket.
Priya Rao: perfect - what's the ticket flow?
Jamal (People Ops): please create a Carryover Exception ticket in the HR portal and attach the signed LOA + manager approval. We'll route to payroll for the balance adjustment. If submitted before the payroll year-end cutoff we can apply the carryover for this fiscal year.
Priya Rao: any blackout dates I should be aware of around hires or product launches? want to avoid taking PTO during a big release.
Jamal (People Ops): product release blackout is 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-21 for core on-call and launch owners. It's a soft blackout for others. If you return in Sept and plan PTO, confirm with your manager so team coverage is fine.

Jamal (People Ops): got it. We'll confirm final carryover approval once payroll processes year-end adjustments. Expect confirmation email by 2026-12-10.
Priya Rao: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
